rule_name: Registry hive export and directory replication

process.name: reg.exe
process.command_line: reg save hklm\sam C:\Users\Public\s.hiv && reg save hklm\system C:\Users\Public\y.hiv

labels.why: SAM and SYSTEM hives exported to a world-writable directory, followed by a DCSync replication request. Two different credential stores, neither with a routine explanation on a workstation.
